Use the Assistant

Your day and waiting tasks, in one conversation.

Open the Assistant

Choose a usable global Development model in Settings → Agents → Models, then turn on Enable Assistant during setup or in Settings → Agents → Features. Assistant starts off on a fresh installation; existing users keep their setting. Each message uses your model allowance.

  1. Press ⌘J. From a web page, ByteQuay returns to the app first.
  2. Ask what needs attention or about the item you are viewing. On screen includes that item as context; remove its × to leave it out.
  3. Browse Decision, Running, Finished, or Today. Use ← → to page through cards, or View all. Answer approvals and questions on their cards; Esc closes the panel.

While you use another app, a new task alert also shows as a macOS notification; click it to answer. The Dock icon counts the tasks waiting on you, and ⇧⌘J opens the one that has waited longest. Press it again for the next.

When chat is off or your agent needs reconnecting, task notices and approval buttons remain available. Saved conversation history is preserved.

Let it act when you ask

In Settings → Agents → Features, optionally enable Assistant can start tasks or Assistant can answer tasks. Both are off by default and are separate from enabling Assistant conversation.

  • Start tasks: ask it to start work on an item. The task uses your saved automation settings.
  • Answer tasks: send your reply to an idle task or answer a question. For supported command approvals inside the sandbox, allow once or deny; other approvals require the card’s buttons.
  • Each action leaves a receipt showing the words it acted on. Open takes you to the task; Stop cancels the first turn of a task it started.

The Assistant does not edit files or run code itself. Development work happens in the tasks it starts.

Enable the optional daily agenda in Settings → Agents → Features to populate Today; generating it uses a model session.
